data.gender_notes: Afaque is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Urdu word 'afaq', meaning 'horizon'. It signifies one who is responsible and trustworthy, as they span the vast expanse of life's horizons. The name Afaque carries the meaning “Responsible, Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afaque usually hope their child will grow to embody responsible, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Afaque
